approved_proposition: 接受 P00 施工前技术结论，按固定 S1 计划一次授权完整六包代码施工、Controller 提交推送、限定临时目录/假进程/私有本地 IPC/构建测试；不授权 PR 合并、真实账号与费用、用户数据迁移、外部监听、麦克风及安装发布。

authorized_write_scope.include: Only the 19 approved task cards, their declared same-domain tests, Controller integration and S1 execution receipts. This authorization adds governance/start records, not unrestricted repository write scope.
authorized_write_scope.exclude: Read-source paths are not write permission. packages/room, packages/seat-runtime and root crates remain read-only references; original audit/plan branches and payloads remain fixed.

allowed_test_effects: Build and test approved S1 changes in isolated workspaces; inspect lifecycle scripts first and obey pinned dependency constraints.
Dedicated temporary roots with synthetic data: real file/OS lock, fsync, crash/recovery and corruption fixtures within that test scope.
Known fake CLI/helper child processes and controlled S1 test-host processes with recorded identity, containment, cleanup and residual custody.
Private per-user local IPC (named pipe or Unix-domain socket) between those test processes; no external network listener.
Authorized production-mutation copies for implementation validation, with tests preserved; no changes to live user workspaces.
controller_permissions: Create/use one S1 integration branch and isolated worktrees
Commit and push only scoped implementation/tests and receipts
Use a dedicated draft PR as task and evidence carrier; no merge or auto-merge
not_authorized: Force-push, reset/clean or overwrite user work
Real product-provider accounts, login/logout, credentials or paid calls
External listener, live daemon/Tailscale or mobile/remote activation
Product installation/update/registry/readiness on user systems, signing, release, publishing or TestFlight
S2/S3 or any work package outside the six authorized S1 packages
Changing architecture/contracts/safety/acceptance, role permissions, global settings or unapproved dependencies

platform_policy.continuous: Proceed through all three S1 waves without per-task reapproval when dependencies and approved gates pass. Ordinary build/debug stays in Codex.
platform_policy.escalate: Stop only affected paths for real scope/contract/safety decisions; continue independent safe tasks. After S1, return research/design to GPT. Do not repeatedly redesign each WP.

team_policy: Use fixed project Sol/Luna/Astra roles; verify actual session identity/tools/slots, do not claim config implies a running agent. Workers do not commit/push. Fresh reviewers do not self-accept. No extra sessions to bypass capacity; Grok/Claude are not newly authorized by this record.
start_conditions: Verify actual Git baseline and dirty state without discarding user work
Confirm effective role/tool/sandbox/platform capabilities; preserve restrictions
Report acceptance receipt with actual branch/HEAD and first task; missing Windows means platform checks remain blocked, not PASS
implementation_acceptance: Six products, 33 S1-due checks, required independent reviews, controlled end-to-end demonstration and full retained deferred obligations. Authorization does not mark any check complete.
historical_state_rule: Plan TASKS and CODEX_HANDOFF at the approved SHA retain their pre-authorization PENDING fields. This later explicit Owner record changes authorization only; do not edit the frozen plan to make its validator pass or rewrite B/C/D history.
identity_note: This record is pinned by its actual Git commit in the external handoff; it does not predict its own SHA.
